content.text: The company wants uni_owns_option_to_assign instead of uni_owns_option_to_licence. This would allow full assignment of IP, which could block publication and academic use permanently. However, the schema shows uni_owns_option_to_assign retains academic use until assignment. This is acceptable if publication rights are preserved. Let me accept this as it meets our core needs: publication rights (60 days), background IP protected, university ownership until assignment exercised.
